changeSummary: Adds cue timing and its provenance. Additive: a version-one record carries neither field and still decodes as untimed, so no stored data is rewritten.

meaning.none: plain text only; no cues, and no reading position may be derived
meaning.published: the feed's own timed transcript (WebVTT, SRT, or podcast JSON)
meaning.aligned: produced by Wilted's speech-to-text against this exact audio revision

timing.rationale: Timing is provenance, not formatting. A paragraph split by a words-per-minute guess is not evidence of when anything was said and must never drive a reading position or an audio cut, so it is never recorded as timed at all.

cues.ordering: non-decreasing startSeconds; overlap permitted because published captions routinely overlap
cues.readingPosition: the last cue whose startSeconds has passed; nil before the first cue

invariants: timing == none if and only if cues are absent
cues are permitted only for available or stale content
a schema-version-1 record carries neither timing nor cues
cues are bound to the RevisionID they were measured against; cutting audio produces a new revision with remapped cues rather than editing these in place

persistence.rollback: v6 stores contain no timing columns; migration adds nullable timing and cue columns and does not rewrite existing transcript text

cloudKit.cueTransport: zlib-compressed cue JSON in a Bytes field, because a three-hour episode's timing is the largest thing the record carries and the plain text is already spending the byte budget
